scope.definition: Lexically public classes, own methods/properties/fields/constants, type aliases, and selected Python protocols; inherited methods link to their declaring class. Public contracts map to implementation references. Generated dataclass constructors, configuration, CLI, collections and typed/dynamic Faker providers are supplemental entries.
scope.exclusions: Private helpers/modules and TYPE_CHECKING-only implementation aliases are individually justified. Underscore implementation details are not promoted to supported APIs.
